_doc: Keys (or prefixes) the locale pruner must never delete, regardless of static analysis. Use this when a key is provably referenced at runtime but the scanner can't see it (joined-string roots, cross-function plumbing, property access in templates, etc.). Add entries with a one-line comment in the trailing _notes block so reviewers can challenge each one.

_notes.commands.personal.deliberatetriggermode: Dynamic ${selectedMode}_title|description via getString('mode'); selectedMode flows through getString return value the scanner can't follow.
_notes.commands.personal.custom_models.remove: checkbox_{capability}_label[_continued] built in customModelRemovalModal.ts via joined-string root ['commands','personal','custom_models','remove'].join('.').
_notes.commands.config.custom_models.remove: Same as personal — different root, same joined-string pattern.
_notes.commands.config.custom_models.capability: ${capability}_title and _edit_title built in custom-endpoint add/edit commands via getString/property access.
_notes.commands.help.speech: ${engine}.description/steps_title/steps_description built in help/speech.ts; engine is a loop variable.
_notes.commands.help.transcription: Same as help.speech but for transcription.
_notes.commands.config.thinking-level: choice_${value} built in parameters.ts via array iteration.
_notes.commands.personal.provider: capability_${capability} built in personal/provider/toggle-models.ts via function parameter.
_notes.commands.server.deliberate-tool-trigger: action_${action} built via ACTIONS const + setStringOption value: ${action}; safety net since the pattern is fragile.
_notes.genai.google: ${messageKey} for streaming error messages; key flows through provider adapter chains the scanner can't trace.
